evidence.text: Leito et al. reported RNU2-2 variants in 141 individuals, including 35 with dominant pathogenic variants and 91 affected members from 73 families with biallelic variants, noting recessive RNU2-2 NDD is at least twice as frequent as the dominant form.

source.title: Systematic analysis of snRNA genes reveals frequent RNU2-2 variants in dominant and recessive developmental and epileptic encephalopathies
source.quote: We report RNU2-2 variants in 141 individuals, including 35 with recurrent dominant pathogenic variants and 91 affected members from 73 families with biallelic variants. Recessive RNU2-2 NDD is at least twice as frequent as the dominant form

evidence.text: A clinical resource guide confirms the Leito et al. discovery cohort of 141 individuals from 122 families with dominant and recessive RNU2-2 variants, with recessive cases occurring at least twice as frequently.
